headline: President Bush changed an earlier order that set up the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13285, which created the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation. That council is an advisory group on volunteer service and civic involvement. The title does not say what specific changes were made, so the details of this amendment are not clear from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation
who_it_affects.how: The rules for the council they serve on were changed in some way not described in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, January 26, 2007 (not stated in the available material)
